title: Added companion projects are gone after the companion is stopped
objective: Projects added to the companion's project list remain listed after the companion is stopped normally and started again.
goal: Projects added with "Add project" stay listed while the companion runs, but after the companion is stopped normally (Ctrl-C or a stop signal) and started again, only the starting project is listed. Added projects must remain listed after a normal stop and restart.
criteria: Projects added before a normal stop (SIGINT or SIGTERM) are listed after the companion starts again, and selecting one shows its own runs.
The saved list keeps its format and private permissions, and no temporary project-list file is left behind after a stop.
Projects without a .docket directory are still refused and never saved.
out_of_scope: Restoring the last selected project after a restart.
notes: Start the companion with `cd ui && npm start -- --workspace /absolute/project --socket /absolute/private/dir/none.sock`; it prints a private local URL, and the private `--socket` path keeps a manual check away from any live Herdr server.

The project list is saved to `$XDG_STATE_HOME/docket-ui/projects.json` (default `~/.local/state/docket-ui/projects.json`); use a private `XDG_STATE_HOME` and disposable projects for any manual check, never real companion state.

Prerequisites: Node.js 22+ and Python 3.11+ as `python3`. The companion's npm dependencies are already installed in `ui/node_modules` and the machine may be offline, so do not reinstall, update or remove them.
